# `<dev/protocols/fbdrv.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Driver side of the display stack.

A display driver connects to gfxsvc ("/svc/gfx"), which owns the public API in fb.h. The driver shares one control page with gfxsvc and hands over its framebuffer and an event.

```c
#include <dev/protocols/fbdrv.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fbdrv_provide"></a>`FBDRV_PROVIDE` | `0x101` | Offer the control page to gfxsvc. Grants the page; replies [FbDrvConnectReply](#fbdrvconnectreply) and grants gfxsvc's doorbell. |
| <a id="fbdrv_setbuf"></a>`FBDRV_SETBUF` | `0x102` | Hand over the framebuffer memory object. Grants it; [FbDrvRequest](#fbdrvrequest). |
| <a id="fbdrv_notify"></a>`FBDRV_NOTIFY` | `0x103` | Give gfxsvc the driver's event; arg is the bit to ring. Grants the event; [FbDrvRequest](#fbdrvrequest). |
| <a id="fbdrv_watch"></a>`FBDRV_WATCH` | `0x104` | Tie the connection to the driver's life. Grants a port the driver owns; [FbDrvRequest](#fbdrvrequest). |
| <a id="fbdrv_fence"></a>`FBDRV_FENCE()` |  | Full memory barrier between writes to the control page and ringing the other side. |

## Structures

### `FbDrvCtl` { #fbdrvctl }

The page shared between a display driver and gfxsvc. The first six fields belong to the driver and are constant after FBDRV_PROVIDE. gfxsvc writes the next three and then rings the driver, `flip_seq` last. The driver writes the last two and then rings gfxsvc.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `width` | `uint32_t` | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | `uint32_t` | Height in pixels. |
| `stride` | `uint32_t` | Bytes from one row to the next. |
| `format` | `uint32_t` | An FB_FMT_* value. |
| `buffers` | `uint32_t` | Images in the framebuffer memory object. |
| `buf_size` | `uint32_t` | Bytes per image, a whole number of pages. |
| `flip_index` | `volatile uint32_t` | Image to show next. |
| `flip_seq` | `volatile uint32_t` | Bumped for each flip request, after `flip_index`. |
| `vsync_on` | `volatile uint32_t` | Non-zero while vertical-sync events are wanted. |
| `flip_ack` | `volatile uint32_t` | The `flip_seq` whose image is now on screen. |
| `vsync_seq` | `volatile uint32_t` | Bumped by the driver for each frame while `vsync_on` is set. |

### `FbDrvRequest` { #fbdrvrequest }

A driver request to gfxsvc after FBDRV_PROVIDE.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | An FBDRV_* value. |
| `arg` | `uint32_t` | Command argument, such as the event bit for FBDRV_NOTIFY. |

### `FbDrvConnectReply` { #fbdrvconnectreply }

gfxsvc's reply to FBDRV_PROVIDE.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](../../../errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK, or an error code. |
| `bit` | `uint32_t` | Bit to ring on gfxsvc's doorbell. |

### `FbDrvConn` { #fbdrvconn }

A driver's connection to gfxsvc.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ctl` | [`FbDrvCtl`](#fbdrvctl) * | The mapped control page. |
| `ctl_mem` | [`Handle`](../../../types.md#handle) | The control page's memory object. |
| `doorbell` | [`Handle`](../../../types.md#handle) | Send-only duplicate of gfxsvc's event. |
| `bit` | `uint32_t` | Bit to ring on `doorbell`. |
| `live` | [`Handle`](../../../types.md#handle) | Port gfxsvc watches to learn when the driver dies. |
